Title
Multi District Wayfinding Contract Amendment for Additional Signs and CRA-
located Riverwalk Signage. CRA staff respectfully request approval of an 
amendment to the existing contract with the following program changes:
•Central Park $21,250 
•Channel District $3,750 
• Downtown $182,935
• Tampa Heights Riverfront $23,858.75
Total = $231,793.75
BACKGROUND:
api(+)’s original multi-district wayfinding scope of work (Resolution No. 2025-651 / Contract 
25-D-00008) included the development and placement of 150 signs. Following field 
verification of each proposed location and a comprehensive inventory of existing CRA-located 
Riverwalk signage, the total program was expanded to 280 signs - comprising 55 right-of-way 
signs and 75 Riverwalk signs - reflecting a more coordinated and complete wayfinding 
network.
FISCAL IMPACT: Yes
FISCAL IMPACT STATEMENT:
This amendment provides an additional $231,793.75 for 130 more signs than originally 
proposed, for a more complete wayfinding network and including updates to the previously 
existing ones, which are over 10 years old, within the Central Park, Channel District, 
Downtown Non-Core and Tampa Heights CRA funds.
